title: [Main]-Stock card report shows incorrect received quantity
summary: Stock Card report now correctly shows received quantities and costs when purchase receipts are split into multiple partial invoices, fixing understated balances that cascaded through the report.
key_points: Report used FindFirst() to read Value Entries, retrieving only the earliest entry when multiple partial invoices existed against one Item Ledger Entry
Replaced FindFirst() with CalcSums() to aggregate all Value Entries for each Item Ledger Entry regardless of partial invoice count
Added ValueEntry.Reset() to prevent filter leakage between records
Received quantity, amount, and cost columns now reflect complete partial invoice totals
Running balance calculations throughout the report are now accurate
